claim: In adult rats, animals given the drug have a larger heart weight than untreated animals after accounting for body mass: in a linear regression of heart weight on treatment status and body mass, the coefficient of treatment status is positive and significant at the one-sided 5% level (t test).

data_keys.meaning: Wet heart weight of each animal, in mg.
Body mass of each animal, in g.
True for animals given the drug, False for untreated animals.

sizes: animals = 48; heart_weight, body_mass and treated each have shape (48,).

claim: Spine density on hippocampal CA1 pyramidal neurons rises with the dose of the drug the animal received: the regression slope of spine density on dose is positive, and a test of the slope gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: spines per 10 micrometres of dendrite on each sampled neuron, in each histological section, of each animal
dose of the drug (mg/kg) that each animal received

sizes: animals = 12; sections = 4; neurons = 25 (spine_density: 12 x 4 x 25 = 1200 values; dose: 12 values)

claim: Participants in the treatment condition report higher liking of the product than participants in the control condition: the difference in mean liking is positive and a two-sided two-sample t test (equal variances assumed) gives p < .05.

data_keys.meaning: liking of the product reported by each participant in the control condition
liking of the product reported by each participant in the treatment condition
willingness to pay for the product reported by each participant in the control condition
willingness to pay for the product reported by each participant in the treatment condition

claim: Across 16 participants, activation in the brain region whose response relates to the personality trait is correlated with the trait: the mean, over the voxels of that region, of the voxel-wise correlations (across participants) between activation and trait score is at least 0.5.

data_keys.meaning: activation of each voxel in each participant, measured in the first scanning session
activation of each voxel in each participant, measured in a second scanning session
questionnaire score on the personality trait for each participant

claim: The mean score of the treatment condition exceeds that of the control condition: the difference in means is positive and a two-sided two-sample t test (equal variances assumed) on all participants gives p < .05.

data_keys.meaning: task score of each participant in the control condition
task score of each participant in the treatment condition

claim: A classifier built from the 50 sensor features separates defective units from sound units with a balanced accuracy (mean of sensitivity and specificity) of at least 0.65 on new units.

data_keys.meaning: 50 features computed from the sensor recording of each unit
True when the unit is defective

claim: The insecticide lowers invertebrate density: the mean density in treated tanks is lower than in control tanks, and a Welch two-sample t test of the difference between the two group means gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: invertebrates per litre counted in each of the water samples taken from each tank
whether the tank received the insecticide

sizes: tanks = 8; samples = 10 (density: 8 x 10 = 80 values; treated: 8 values)

claim: The drug improves motor coordination: the mean time spent on the rotarod is longer in the treatment group than in the control group, and a two-tailed two-sample t test of the difference between the two group means gives p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: time in seconds that each rat stayed on the rotarod on each of the consecutive test days
whether the rat was in the treatment group (true) or the control group (false)

sizes: rats = 10; days = 3 (latency: 10 x 3 = 30 values; treated: 10 values)

claim: Across tumour samples, the expression of gene A and the expression of gene B are positively related after accounting for the expression of gene C: the gain in R-squared when gene A expression is added to a linear regression of gene B expression on gene C expression is at least 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: Quantitative PCR expression signal of gene A in each tumour sample, in arbitrary linear units.
Quantitative PCR expression signal of gene B in each tumour sample, in arbitrary linear units.
Quantitative PCR expression signal of gene C in each tumour sample, in arbitrary linear units.

sizes: samples = 96; gene_a_expression, gene_b_expression and gene_c_expression each have shape (96,).

claim: Over a ten-year record, monthly hospital admissions rose after accounting for catchment population: in a linear regression of monthly admissions on time and catchment population, the coefficient of time is positive and significant at the one-sided 5% level (t test).

data_keys.meaning: Number of hospital admissions in each month.
Catchment population in each month, in thousands.
Time of each month in years since the start of the record.

sizes: months = 120; admissions, population and time_years each have shape (120,).

claim: A shrunken-centroid classifier built from the 1000 gene-expression measurements separates the two tumour classes with an accuracy of at least 0.60 on new samples.

data_keys.meaning: expression level of each gene in each tumour sample
True when the sample belongs to the second tumour class

claim: Prenatal exposure raises adult open-field activity: the mean activity score of offspring of exposed dams is higher than that of offspring of control dams, and a two-sample t test of the difference between the two group means gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: open-field activity score (distance travelled, arbitrary units) measured in adulthood on each pup of each dam
whether the dam received the exposure during pregnancy

sizes: dams = 20; pups = 8 (activity: 20 x 8 = 160 values; exposed: 20 values)

claim: Among the recorded visual neurons that fire more to vertical than to horizontal bars, the mean orientation index, (vertical minus horizontal) / (vertical plus horizontal) computed from trial-averaged firing rates, is at least 0.1.

data_keys.meaning: firing rate (spikes/s) of each neuron on each presentation of a vertical bar
firing rate (spikes/s) of each neuron on each presentation of a horizontal bar

claim: Across the cell lines, the average expression of the probe sets on the published drug-response signature is higher in the cell lines sensitive to the drug than in the resistant cell lines, by at least 0.5 log2 units (Welch two-sample t test on the per-cell-line signature averages, p < .01).

data_keys.meaning: log2 expression of each microarray probe set in each cell line
True if the probe set is on the published drug-response signature list
True if the cell line is classed as sensitive to the drug, False if resistant

claim: In adults with hypertension, the fall in systolic pressure over a 12-week programme is larger in patients with a higher starting pressure: the correlation, across patients, between the fall (first baseline reading minus week-12 reading) and the second baseline reading is at least 0.3.

data_keys.meaning: Systolic blood pressure, first reading at the baseline visit, in mmHg.
Systolic blood pressure, second reading at the baseline visit, in mmHg.
Systolic blood pressure at the week-12 visit, in mmHg.

sizes: patients = 120; sbp_baseline_first, sbp_baseline_second and sbp_week12 each have shape (120,).
